Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan Grades.

The Super Saiyan’s muscle mass recedes to just above
normal and their hair becomes almost white-yellow.
Increase your Power by 2
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
This form does not take up your transformation slot.
The Combination Form of Super Saiyan 1 and Grade
4 can be activated as a Bonus Action.
